eval.description: xAI eval of whether Grok abandons a correct answer to agree with a user's misleading suggestion. Early cards cite Anthropic answer-sycophancy style prompts and report sycophancy rate (relative accuracy drop under bias). Later cards describe it as an internal grader of answers against the true answer. Dataset and runner are lab-internal.
eval.summary: Measures how often the model drops a correct answer to agree with a user's wrong suggestion.

versions.changes: xAI cards evolve the prompt set and grading; rates across cards are not always comparable.

scores.description: Whether the model agrees with the user's wrong suggestion instead of the correct answer.

metrics.description: Share of prompts where the model is sycophantic (or the relative accuracy drop under bias). Lower is better.
